questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'हतोत्साहित' का विलोम शब्द क्या होगा? / What is the antonym of 'Hatotsahit'?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'हतोत्साहित' का सही विलोम 'प्रोत्साहित' (या उत्साहित) होता है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वर्तनी वाले शब्द का चयन कीजिए:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'उत् + ज्वल' की सन्धि से 'उज्ज्वल' (दोनों 'ज' आधे) शुद्ध रूप बनता है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'प्रत्युपकार' (प्रति + उपकार) में कौन सी सन्धि है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. इ/ई के बाद कोई असमान स्वर आने पर 'इ' का 'य्' हो जाता है (इको यणचि), अतः यह यण सन्धि है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'दशानन' में कौन सा समास है जब इसका विग्रह 'दश आनन हैं जिसके अर्थात रावण' किया जाए?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. तीसरे विशेष अर्थ (रावण) का बोध कराने के कारण इसमें बहुव्रीहि समास है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'जो सब कुछ जानता हो' वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'जो सब कुछ जानता हो' उसे सर्वज्ञ कहा जाता है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'मुँह की खाना' मुहावरे का सही अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'मुँह की खाना' मुहावरे का अर्थ पराजित होना या बुरी तरह हारना है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'अंधेर नगरी अनबुझ राजा, टके सेर भाजी टके सेर खाजा' लोकोक्ति का सही अर्थ है:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. जहाँ विवेक और न्याय का अभाव हो, उस कुशासन को दर्शाती है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'मृगया' शब्द का पर्यायवाची शब्द क्या है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'मृगया' का अर्थ अहेर या शिकार होता है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'वाक्यं रसात्मकं काव्यम्' उक्ति किस आचार्य की है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. यह प्रसिद्ध लक्षण 'साहित्यदर्पण' के रचयिता आचार्य विश्वनाथ का है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Hindi] 'पेड़ से पत्ता गिरा' वाक्य में 'पेड़ से' में कौन सा कारक है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. अलगाव (पृथकता) का भाव होने के कारण इसमें अपादान कारक है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Select the correct SYNONYM of the word 'AMELIORATE':
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'Ameliorate' means to make something bad or unsatisfactory better; to improve.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Select the correct ANTONYM of the word 'TACITURN':
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'Taciturn' means reserved or uncommunicative; its antonym is 'garrulous' (talkative).

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Identify the error: 'Hardly had I entered the station than the train left.'
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'Hardly' takes 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. ('No sooner' takes 'than').

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Transform into Passive Voice: 'The board is considering the proposal.'
options: The proposal is being considered by the board.
The proposal was considered by the board.
The proposal has been considered by the board.
The proposal is considered by the board.
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Present Continuous active ('is considering') changes to 'is being considered'.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Convert into Indirect Speech: He said, 'I have completed my research project.'
options: He said that he had completed his research project.
He said that he has completed his research project.
He told he completed his research project.
He said that I had completed my research project.
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Present Perfect changes to Past Perfect in indirect speech.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Fill in the blank: 'She is confident ________ clearing the competitive exam.'
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. The adjective 'confident' takes the preposition 'of' followed by a gerund.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] What is the meaning of the idiom 'To burn the candle at both ends'?
options: To exhaust oneself by working early and late
To be careless about fire safety
To work in two different jobs
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. It means to work extremely hard and get very little rest.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] One-word substitution: 'A person who hates or distrusts humankind.'
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. A 'misanthrope' dislikes and avoids human society.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Identify the figure of speech in: 'The opportunity knocked at his door.'
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Attributing human actions (knocking) to an abstract concept (opportunity) is Personification.

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - English] Select the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. The correct spelling is 'Accommodation' (double 'c' and double 'm').

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'अकुहविसर्जनीयानाम् ________' सूत्र के अनुसार उच्चारण स्थान क्या है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. अ, आ, क-वर्ग, ह तथा विसर्ग का उच्चारण स्थान कण्ठ होता है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'इको यणचि' सूत्र से किस सन्धि का विधान होता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. इक् वर्णों के स्थान पर यण् आदेश होना यण् सन्धि है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'अष्टाध्यायी' ग्रन्थ के रचयिता कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. संस्कृत व्याकरण के महान सूत्रकार महर्षि पाणिनि हैं।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'पितरौ' (माता च पिता च) में कौन सा समास है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. विग्रह में एक ही पद शेष रहने के कारण 'एकशेष द्वंद्व समास' है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'रुच्यर्थानां प्रीयमाणः' सूत्र से किस विभक्ति का विधान होता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'रुच्' धातु के योग में प्रसन्न होने वाले (प्रीयमाण) में चतुर्थी विभक्ति होती है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'गत्वा' पद में कौन सा प्रत्यय है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. गम् + क्त्वा = गत्वा (जाकर)।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] संस्कृत में माहेश्वर सूत्रों की कुल संख्या कितनी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. पाणिनीय व्याकरण में माहेश्वर सूत्रों की संख्या 14 है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'अस्मद्' शब्द का प्रथमा विभक्ति एकवचन रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. अस्मद् सर्वनाम का प्रथमा एकवचन 'अहम्' (मैं) होता है।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] संस्कृत संख्या 'षण्णवतिः' किस संख्या का बोधक है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. षट् (6) + नवतिः (90) = 96 (षण्णवतिः)।

questions.question: [Section 1: Languages - Sanskrit] 'किरातार्जुनीयम्' महाकाव्य के रचयिता कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. अर्थगौरव के लिए प्रसिद्ध महाकवि भारवि किरातार्जुनीयम् के रचयिता हैं।

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Who took charge as the 53rd Chief Justice of India (CJI)? / भारत के 53वें मुख्य न्यायाधीश (CJI) कौन नियुक्त हुए?
options: Justice B.R. Gavai / न्यायमूर्ति बी.आर. गवई
Justice Sanjiv Khanna / न्यायमूर्ति संजीव खन्ना
Justice D.Y. Chandrachud / न्यायमूर्ति डी.वाई. चंद्रचूड़
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Justice Surya Kant assumed office as the 53rd Chief Justice of India.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which city in Uttar Pradesh is being developed as India's first 'AI City'? / उत्तर प्रदेश के किस शहर को भारत की पहली एआई सिटी (AI City) बनाया जा रहा है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Lucknow is being developed as India's first Artificial Intelligence (AI) City.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] What is the name of the spot on the Moon where Chandrayaan-3 landed? / चंद्रयान-3 के चंद्रमा पर लैंडिंग स्थल का नाम क्या रखा गया?
options: Shiv Shakti Point / शिव शक्ति प्वाइंट
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. PM Modi named Chandrayaan-3 touchdown site 'Shiv Shakti Point' (Aug 23 = National Space Day).

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Who was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize 2024? / 2024 का नोबेल शांति पुरस्कार किसे दिया गया?
options: World Food Programme / विश्व खाद्य कार्यक्रम
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Japanese grassroots movement of atomic bomb survivors Nihon Hidankyo won the 2024 Nobel Peace Prize.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which team won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024? / आईसीसी पुरुष टी20 विश्व कप 2024 किस देश ने जीता?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. India defeated South Africa in Barbados to claim the T20 World Cup 2024 trophy.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Where was the grand Maha Kumbh Mela 2025 organized in UP? / उत्तर प्रदेश में महाकुंभ मेला 2025 कहाँ आयोजित हुआ?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Maha Kumbh 2025 took place at Prayagraj Triveni Sangam.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which classical dance form originated in Uttar Pradesh? / उत्तर प्रदेश का पारंपरिक शास्त्रीय नृत्य कौन सा है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Kathak is the classical dance form of North India (Uttar Pradesh).

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] In which district of UP is the Dudhwa National Park located? / उत्तर प्रदेश का दुधवा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस जिले में है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Dudhwa National Park is in Lakhimpur Kheri district.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] What is the State Bird of Uttar Pradesh? / उत्तर प्रदेश का राज्य पक्षी कौन सा है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Sarus Crane is the official state bird of UP.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Who was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution? / भारतीय संविधान की प्रारूप समिति के अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
options: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar / डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर
Dr. Rajendra Prasad / डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution under Article 51A by which Amendment? / मूल कर्तव्यों को 51A के तहत किस संशोधन से जोड़ा गया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act 1976 added Fundamental Duties.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which Article is known as the 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution'? / किस अनुच्छेद को संविधान का 'हृदय और आत्मा' कहा गया है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Article 32 (Right to Constitutional Remedies) was termed heart & soul by Dr. Ambedkar.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Minimum age required to become the President of India is: / भारत का राष्ट्रपति बनने हेतु न्यूनतम आयु कितनी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Article 58 prescribes minimum 35 years of age.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which Governor-General abolished the practice of Sati in 1829? / 1829 में सती प्रथा का अंत किसने किया था?
options: Lord William Bentinck / लॉर्ड विलियम बैंटिंक
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Lord William Bentinck enacted the Sati Regulation Act in 1829.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] In which session of INC was 'Purna Swaraj' declared as the goal in 1929? / 1929 के किस अधिवेशन में 'पूर्ण स्वराज' का लक्ष्य घोषित हुआ?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Jawaharlal Nehru presided over the 1929 Lahore Session.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Champaran Satyagraha of 1917 was related to: / 1917 का चंपारण सत्याग्रह किससे संबंधित था?
options: Cotton mill workers / सूती मिल मजदूर
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Gandhi's first satyagraha in India was against Tinkathia indigo farming.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which gas is primarily responsible for Global Warming? / ग्लोबल वार्मिंग हेतु मुख्य गैस कौन सी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. CO2 is the primary greenhouse gas driving global warming.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Where is the headquarters of UNESCO located? / यूनेस्को का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. UNESCO headquarters is in Paris, France.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] World Environment Day is celebrated on: / विश्व पर्यावरण दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. World Environment Day is observed every year on June 5.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which river is known as the 'Dakshin Ganga'? / किस नदी को 'दक्षिण गंगा' कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Godavari is the longest peninsular river and is called Dakshin Ganga.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Highest peak in South India is: / दक्षिण भारत की सबसे ऊंची चोटी कौन सी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Anamudi (2,695m) in Kerala is the highest peak in South India.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] McMahon Line separates India and: / मैकमोहन रेखा भारत और किस देश को अलग करती है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. McMahon Line is the effective boundary between India and China.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Who was the first Indian to receive a Nobel Prize? / नोबेल पुरस्कार पाने वाले प्रथम भारतीय कौन थे?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Rabindranath Tagore won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913 for Gitanjali.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Where is the headquarters of RBI located? / भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. RBI headquarters is situated in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

questions.question: [Section 2: GK & Current Affairs] Which state has the longest coastline in India? / भारत में किस राज्य की तटरेखा सबसे लंबी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Gujarat possesses the longest coastline (~1,600 km) in mainland India.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] If 15% of a number is 45, what is 40% of that number? / यदि किसी संख्या का 15% मान 45 है, तो उसका 40% मान क्या होगा?
[Section 3: Mathematics] Average of first 50 natural numbers is: / प्रथम 50 प्राकृतिक संख्याओं का औसत क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Average = (n + 1)/2 = 51 / 2 = 25.5.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] Find the compound interest on ₹10,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years compounded annually. / ₹10,000 का 10% दर से 2 वर्ष का चक्रवर्द्धि ब्याज क्या होगा?

[Section 3: Mathematics] Selling price of an article is ₹450 with a loss of 10%. To gain 20% profit, selling price should be: / 10% हानि पर वस्तु ₹450 में बेची गई। 20% लाभ के लिए विक्रय मूल्य क्या होगा?
[Section 3: Mathematics] Two numbers are in ratio 3:4. If their HCF is 4, find their LCM. / दो संख्याएं 3:4 के अनुपात में हैं। HCF 4 है, तो LCM क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. LCM = ratio product * HCF = 3 * 4 * 4 = 48.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] If perimeter of a square is 48 cm, its area is: / यदि वर्ग का परिमाप 48 सेमी है, तो क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Side = 48 / 4 = 12 cm. Area = 12^2 = 144 sq cm.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] Speed of a car covering 180 km in 3 hours in m/s is: / 3 घंटे में 180 किमी दूरी तय करने वाली कार की चाल मी/से में क्या होगी?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Speed = 60 km/h = 60 * (5/18) = 16.67 m/s.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] If 12 men complete a work in 18 days, 9 men will complete it in: / 12 पुरुष काम 18 दिन में करते हैं, 9 पुरुष इसे कितने दिन में करेंगे?
[Section 3: Mathematics] Length & breadth increased by 10% and 20%. Percentage increase in area is: / लंबाई 10% और चौड़ाई 20% बढ़ाई गई। क्षेत्रफल में % वृद्धि क्या होगी?
[Section 3: Mathematics] Value of (x^2 - 9) / (x - 3) at x = 5 is: / x = 5 पर (x^2 - 9)/(x - 3) का मान क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Simplified = x + 3. At x = 5, 5 + 3 = 8.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] Sum of interior angles of a convex Hexagon (6 sides) is: / षट्भुज (6 भुजाओं) के अंतः कोणों का योग कितना होता है?
[Section 3: Mathematics] If radius of a circle is doubled, its area becomes: / यदि वृत्त की त्रिज्या दोगुनी कर दी जाए, तो क्षेत्रफल कितने गुना हो जाएगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Area is proportional to r^2. Doubling r makes area 4 times.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] Median of 12, 15, 11, 19, 23, 16, 17 is: / आंकड़ों 12, 15, 11, 19, 23, 16, 17 की माध्यिका क्या होगी?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Ascending order: 11, 12, 15, 16, 17, 19, 23. 4th term = 16.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] Supplementary angle of 65° is: / 65° का संपूरक कोण क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Supplementary sum = 180°. Required angle = 180° - 65° = 115°.

questions.question: [Section 3: Mathematics] Simplify: 25 - [4 + {16 - (12 - 2)}] / व्यंजक 25 - [4 + {16 - (12 - 2)}] को सरल करें:
[Section 3: Mathematics] If x + 1/x = 4, then x^2 + 1/x^2 is: / यदि x + 1/x = 4 है, तो x^2 + 1/x^2 का मान क्या होगा?
[Section 4: Science] What is the SI unit of luminous intensity? / ज्योति तीव्रता का SI मात्रक क्या है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. SI unit of luminous intensity is Candela (cd).

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] Rocket propulsion works on Newton's Third Law and principle of: / रॉकेट नोदन किस संरक्षण सिद्धांत पर आधारित है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Rocket propulsion works on Conservation of Linear Momentum and Newton's Third Law.

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] Which gland regulates calcium level in human blood? / मानव रक्त में कैल्शियम नियंत्रित करने वाली ग्रंथि कौन सी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Parathyroid gland secretes PTH to regulate blood calcium levels.

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] pH value of acid rain is generally: / अम्लीय वर्षा का pH मान कितना होता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Rainwater with pH less than 5.6 is categorized as Acid Rain.

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] Viticulture refers to the cultivation of: / 'विटीकल्चर' किसके उत्पादन से संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Viticulture is the science and cultivation of grapes.

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] Which of the following vitamins is water-soluble? / कौन सा विटामिन जल में घुलनशील है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Vitamin B & C are water-soluble; A, D, E, K are fat-soluble.

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] What type of image is formed on human retina? / मानव रेटिना पर बनने वाला प्रतिबिंब कैसा होता है?
options: Real and Inverted / वास्तविक और उल्टा
Virtual and Erect / आभासी और सीधा
Real and Erect / वास्तविक और सीधा
Virtual and Inverted / आभासी और उल्टा
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Eye lens forms a real, inverted, and smaller image on retina.

questions.question: [Section 4: Science] Which metal is stored in kerosene due to high reactivity with air and water? / किस धातु को मिट्टी के तेल में रखा जाता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Sodium reacts vigorously with air and water, so it is stored in kerosene.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Which gas layer absorbs harmful UV radiation in atmosphere? / पराबैंगनी किरणों को कौन सी परत अवशोषित करती है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Ozone layer in Stratosphere absorbs harmful UV rays.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Highest peak in Western Ghats is: / पश्चिमी घाट की सबसे ऊंची चोटी कौन सी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Anamudi (2,695m) in Kerala is the highest peak in Western Ghats.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Article abolishing Untouchability in Constitution is: / अस्पृश्यता का उन्मूलन करने वाला अनुच्छेद कौन सा है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Article 17 abolishes untouchability in India.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Who established 'Satyashodhak Samaj' in 1873? / 1873 में 'सत्यशोधक समाज' की स्थापना किसने की थी?
options: Raja Ram Mohan Roy / राजा राममोहन राय
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Jyotirao Phule founded Satyashodhak Samaj for social reform.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] World Biodiversity Day is celebrated on: / अंतर्राष्ट्रीय जैव विविधता दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. World Biodiversity Day is observed on May 22.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Which soil is also known as 'Regur Soil'? / किस मिट्टी को 'रेगुड़ मृदा' भी कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Black cotton soil is famously known as Regur soil.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Chipko Movement was led by: / चिपको आंदोलन का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
options: Chandi Prasad Bhatt / चंडी प्रसाद भट्ट
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Sundarlal Bahuguna led Chipko Movement in Uttarakhand for forest conservation.

questions.question: [Section 5: EVS & Social Studies] Loktak Lake is located in which state? / लोकटक झील किस राज्य में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Loktak freshwater lake is located in Manipur.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] Micro-teaching concept was introduced by: / सूक्ष्म शिक्षण की अवधारणा किसने विकसित की थी?
options: Dwight W. Allen / ड्वाइट डब्ल्यू. एलन
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Dwight W. Allen developed micro-teaching at Stanford University in 1963.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] Duration of NCERT micro-teaching cycle is: / NCERT प्रतिमान अनुसार सूक्ष्म शिक्षण चक्र की अवधि कितनी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. NCERT micro-teaching cycle duration is 36 minutes.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] Operation Blackboard scheme was launched under: / 'ऑपरेशन ब्लैकबोर्ड' योजना किस शिक्षा नीति से संबंधित है?
options: National Policy on Education 1986 / राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 1986
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Operation Blackboard was launched in 1987 under NPE 1986.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] According to RTE 2009, Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) for primary classes is: / RTE 2009 अनुसार प्राथमिक स्तर पर छात्र-शिक्षक अनुपात है:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. RTE 2009 specifies 30:1 ratio for primary schools.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] Minimum instructional hours in an academic year for primary teachers under RTE is: / प्राथमिक स्तर पर वार्षिक न्यूनतम शिक्षण घंटे हैं:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. RTE mandates 200 working days and 800 instructional hours.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] Project Method of teaching was propounded by: / प्रोजेक्ट विधि के प्रतिपादक कौन हैं?
options: William Heard Kilpatrick / विलियम हर्ड किलपैट्रिक
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. W.H. Kilpatrick developed Project Method based on Pragmatism.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] Kindergarten method of education was created by: / किंडरगार्टन प्रणाली के जनक कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Friedrich Froebel introduced Kindergarten system in Germany.

questions.question: [Section 6: Teaching Skills] Heuristic method of teaching was developed by: / 'ह्यूरिस्टिक विधि' का विकास किसने किया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Prof H.E. Armstrong developed the Heuristic (discovery) method.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] Who is known as the 'Father of Child Psychology'? / बाल मनोविज्ञान के जनक कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. G. Stanley Hall initiated child study movement.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] According to Piaget, 'Object Permanence' develops in: / पियाजे अनुसार 'वस्तु स्थायित्व' किस अवस्था में विकसित होता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Object permanence emerges during Sensorimotor stage (0-2 years).

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] Concept of 'Zone of Proximal Development' (ZPD) was given by: / ZPD की अवधारणा किसने दी?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Lev Vygotsky formulated ZPD in Social Constructivism.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] Who proposed 'Trial and Error Theory' using cats? / 'प्रयास एवं त्रुटि सिद्धांत' किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Thorndike proposed Trial and Error theory using cats.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] Classical Conditioning theory was propounded by: / शास्त्रीय अनुबंधन का सिद्धांत किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Pavlov demonstrated Classical Conditioning in dogs.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] IQ formula [MA/CA * 100] was completed by: / IQ का पूर्ण सूत्र किसने प्रतिपादित किया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Lewis Terman multiplied Stern's ratio by 100 in 1916.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] Who propounded Two-Factor Theory of Intelligence (G and S factors)? / बुद्धि का द्वि-कारक सिद्धांत किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Spearman proposed G (General) and S (Specific) factors.

questions.question: [Section 7: Child Psychology] 'Multiple Intelligences Theory' was formulated by: / 'बहु-बुद्धि सिद्धांत' किसने प्रतिपादित किया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Howard Gardner proposed Multiple Intelligences Theory in 1983.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] According to Constitution Article 21A, Education is a: / संविधान अनुच्छेद 21A अनुसार शिक्षा है:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Article 21A grants Fundamental Right to Education for 6-14 years.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Primary role of a teacher in modern child-centered classroom is: / बाल-केंद्रित कक्षा में शिक्षक की भूमिका है:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Modern pedagogy envisions teacher as a facilitator.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Internal motivation is driven by: / आंतरिक अभिप्रेरणा का मुख्य कारक है:
options: Self-satisfaction and interest / आत्म-संतोष एवं रुचि
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Intrinsic motivation stems from personal interest and self-satisfaction.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Which reward best supports intrinsic motivation? / आंतरिक प्रेरणा हेतु सर्वोत्तम पुनर्बलन है:
options: Informational verbal praise / सूचनात्मक मौखिक प्रशंसा
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Verbal praise focused on effort fosters intrinsic motivation.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Article 51A(k) lays down fundamental duty of: / अनुच्छेद 51A(k) किसका कर्तव्य निर्धारित करता है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Article 51A(k) obligates parents to provide education opportunities.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Who propounded Need Hierarchy Theory of Motivation? / 'आवश्यकता पदानुक्रम सिद्धांत' किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Abraham Maslow proposed 5-level Need Hierarchy Theory.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] Professional ethics demand teachers treat students: / शिक्षकों की व्यावसायिक नीति-शास्त्र मांग करती है:
options: Equitably without discrimination / निष्पक्ष एवं समतापूर्ण
Based on social status / सामाजिक स्तर अनुसार
Based on marks only / केवल अंकों आधार पर
Based on personal choice / व्यक्तिगत पसंद पर
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Professional ethics require unbiased, fair treatment to all.

questions.question: [Section 8: Life Skills & Management] CCE stands for in evaluation: / मूल्यांकन में CCE का पूर्ण रूप है:
options: Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation / सतत एवं व्यापक मूल्यांकन
Class Child Evaluation / कक्षा बाल मूल्यांकन
Comprehensive Course Evaluation / व्यापक कोर्स मूल्यांकन
Central Child Education / केंद्रीय बाल शिक्षा
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. CCE = Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation.

questions.question: [Section 9: Logical Reasoning] Select the Odd One Out: / समूह में से भिन्न शब्द चुनिए:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Brass is an alloy; Copper, Zinc, Iron are pure elements.

questions.question: [Section 9: Logical Reasoning] If 'TEACHER' is coded as 'VGCEJFT', how is 'STUDENT' coded? / यदि 'TEACHER' = 'VGCEJFT', तो 'STUDENT' = ?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Pattern is +2 for each letter. S(+2)=U, T(+2)=W, U(+2)=W, D(+2)=F, E(+2)=G, N(+2)=P, T(+2)=V.

questions.question: [Section 9: Logical Reasoning] Pointing to a photo, a man said 'That man's father is my father's son.' Whose photo was it? / 'उस आदमी का पिता मेरे पिता का बेटा है।' तस्वीर किसकी थी?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 'My father's son' = himself. That man's father = himself. Photo is of his son.

questions.question: [Section 9: Logical Reasoning] If 1st Jan 2024 was Monday, what day was 31st Dec 2024? / यदि 1 जन 2024 को सोमवार था, तो 31 दिसं 2024 को कौन सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. 2024 is a Leap Year (+1 extra odd day). Monday + 1 = Tuesday.

questions.question: [Section 9: Logical Reasoning] Complete series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ? / श्रृंखला पूरी करें: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. Differences are +4, +6, +8, +10, +12. 30 + 12 = 42.

questions.question: [Section 10: IT] What is the full form of CPU? / सीपीयू (CPU) का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
options: Central Processing Unit / सेंट्रल प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट
Central Program Unit / सेंट्रल प्रोग्राम यूनिट
Control Processing Unit / कंट्रोल प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट
Computer Power Unit / कंप्यूटर पावर यूनिट
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. CPU = Central Processing Unit.

questions.question: [Section 10: IT] Which of the following is a Volatile Memory? / कौन सी एक अस्थाई/वोलाटाइल मेमोरी है?
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. RAM loses its data when power is switched off.

questions.question: [Section 10: IT] URL stands for in web browser addresses: / यूआरएल (URL) का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
options: Uniform Resource Locator / यूनिफॉर्म रिसोर्स लोकेटर
Universal Resource Link / यूनिवर्सल रिसोर्स लिंक
Uniform Resource Link / यूनिफॉर्म रिसोर्स लिंक
United Resource Locator / यूनाइटेड रिसोर्स लोकेटर
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. URL = Uniform Resource Locator.

questions.question: [Section 10: IT] In MS-PowerPoint, key used to start slideshow from beginning is: / पावरपॉइंट में प्रारंभ से स्लाइड शो चलाने की शॉर्टकट कुंजी है:
questions.explanation: +3 Marks / -1 Mark. F5 starts the slideshow from the first slide.
